DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談の予約についてですね。差し支えない範囲で、相談したい内容を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about booking a consultation. Could you tell me what you would like to discuss, as far as you feel comfortable sharing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住まいに関する書類をもらいましたが、内容がよくわかりません。書類を見ながら相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 理解できない住まいの書類を見ながら相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received some housing documents, but I do not really understand them. I would like to discuss them while looking at the documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to discuss housing documents you do not understand while looking at them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相談内容に合う担当を確認します。予約の際に、説明の方法で希望することはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check who handles that subject. When booking, do you have any preferences about how things are explained?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 日本語で長く説明するのが苦手です。短い文で話していただいたり、重要な言葉を書いていただいたりできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 短い文と重要語の記録による補助を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I find lengthy explanations in Japanese difficult. Could you speak in short sentences or write down important words for me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for help through short sentences and written key words. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご希望を担当へ伝え、対応できるか確認します。同行を希望する方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will pass your preferences on to the person in charge and check whether they can accommodate them. Is there anyone you would like to come with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人が一緒に来られるかもしれません。同行できるかと、友人が来られない場合の方法も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の同行と来られない場合の対応を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: A friend may be able to come with me. I would like to ask whether they can accompany me and what to do if they cannot come.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether your friend can accompany you and what happens if they cannot. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どちらも確認項目に入れましょう。相談の予約方法と必要な準備を、担当先からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us include both points to check. The relevant office will explain how to book the consultation and what you need to prepare.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 予約する前に、相談の内容と説明の希望を伝えるのですね。担当先へ連絡するときの言い方をメモしてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 担当先へ相談内容と希望を伝える準備をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: So before booking, I should explain what I want to discuss and how I would like it explained. May I make a note of what to say when contacting that office?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prepare to explain your consultation topic and preferences to the relevant office. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 「住まいの書類について相談したい」と伝え、ご希望を添えてください。日時は担当先が空きを確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Say, “I would like to discuss some housing documents,” and add your preferences. The office will check availability and tell you the date and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相談の概要と短い説明の希望、友人の同行を伝えます。担当先に準備する物と予約できる日時を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 説明の希望と同行を伝え持ち物と日時を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain the general topic, my preference for short explanations, and that my friend may accompany me. I will ask the office what to prepare and which dates and times I can book.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain your preferences and accompanying friend, and ask what to bring and when. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 相談の入口が整理できました。確認した担当先の案内をお渡ししますね。本日はお立ち寄りいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have clarified how to get started with the consultation. I will give you information about the office we checked. Thank you for stopping by today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 会計はお済みですか。書類について何かご相談がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished paying? Is there anything about documents you would like to ask about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会計は済みました。職場から受診したことがわかる書類を求められましたが、この領収書でよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 領収書が受診の書類として足りるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have paid. My workplace has asked for a document showing that I saw a doctor. Would this receipt be sufficient?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the receipt is sufficient as proof of a medical visit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 職場が何を必要としているか、こちらだけでは判断できません。書類名や指定された内容は聞いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot determine on our own what your workplace needs. Have they told you the document's name or what it must contain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 書類の名前は聞いていません。受診した日の確認だけなのか、ほかの内容も必要なのか職場に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 職場に書類名と必要内容を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They have not told me the name. I will ask whether they only need confirmation of the date of the visit or other information as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the document name and required information with your workplace. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できたら、該当する書類の相談窓口へつなぎます。発行については担当が内容を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once you have checked, I will direct you to the desk handling that document. The person responsible will check the details regarding issuance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に書類をお願いするのではなく、必要な内容がわかってから相談します。今もらった紙はすべて保管しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 必要内容がわかるまで依頼せず受取済みの紙を保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than requesting a document first, I will consult you once I know what information is needed. I will keep all the papers I have just received.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not request a document until the requirements are known, and keep the papers already received. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、お手元の紙を確認に使えます。職場へ相談するとき、気になることはほかにもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, those papers can be used to check the details. Is there anything else concerning you when you ask your workplace?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 詳しい病気の内容まで必要なのかが気になります。どこまで求められているか、職場に確認してからこちらへ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 病気の詳細まで必要か職場に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am concerned about whether they need detailed information about my illness. I will check how much they require and then tell you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask your workplace whether detailed information about the illness is needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な範囲がわかってから、担当へご相談ください。費用や受取時期についても、その際に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please consult the person responsible once you know the required scope. You can also check the fee and when you can collect it then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 書類名と必要な内容を職場に聞き、領収書を持って担当窓口へ相談します。発行前に費用と受取時期も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 職場の条件を確認し発行の費用と受取時期を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask my workplace for the document name and required information, and bring the receipt to the relevant desk. Before it is issued, I will also check the fee and collection time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check your workplace's requirements and ask about the issuance fee and collection time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認する点がそろいましたね。私はここまでのご相談を担当へ伝えます。お帰りの前に紙をなくさないようご確認ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have identified the points to check. I will pass what we have discussed on to the person responsible. Before leaving, please check that you have all your papers so you do not lose them. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 落とし物のご相談ですね。何をなくされたか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about a lost item. Please tell me what you have lost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鍵が三本付いた束をなくしました。黒い布のキーホルダーが付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三本の鍵と黒い布のキーホルダーを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lost a bunch of three keys. It has a black fabric key ring attached.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the three keys and black fabric key ring. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に鍵を見たのは、どのような場面でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: What was happening when you last saw the keys?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 朝、家を出るときに使いました。その後、買い物をして帰宅したときにないと気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最後に使った朝と紛失に気づいた帰宅時を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I used them when leaving home this morning. After that, I went shopping and noticed they were missing when I got home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish using them in the morning from noticing the loss when returning home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 家を出てから帰るまでの間ですね。立ち寄った場所で、鍵を取り出した記憶はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So it was between leaving home and returning. Do you remember taking the keys out at any place you visited?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 店でかばんを開けましたが、鍵を出したかは覚えていません。店にも届いていないか問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店で鍵を出したか不明だと説明し問い合わせを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I opened my bag at a shop, but I do not remember whether I took the keys out. I will also ask the shop whether anyone has handed them in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you are unsure whether you took the keys out at the shop, and decide to ask there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確かな記憶と曖昧なところを分けておきましょう。鍵以外に、束に付いていた物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us distinguish what you remember clearly from what is uncertain. Was anything besides the keys attached to the bunch?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小さな青い輪も付いています。名前や住所を書いた札は付けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 青い輪と名前や住所の札がないことを知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is also a small blue ring. There is no tag with my name or address on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention the blue ring and that there is no name or address tag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 特徴を確認しました。追加の確認やご連絡に使える方法を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have noted the identifying features. May I ask how we can contact you or check further details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この電話番号で連絡を受けられます。届いているか店にも聞き、わかったことがあればこちらへ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電話番号を示し店でわかった情報を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: You can contact me at this phone number. I will ask the shop whether the keys have been handed in and let you know if I learn anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your phone number and say you will report information learned at the shop. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 連絡先を確認しておきます。立ち寄り先で新しい情報がわかったらお伝えください。鍵が見つかるとよいですね。お帰りはお気を付けて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will record your contact details. Please tell us if you get new information from somewhere you visited. I hope your keys turn up. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票をお持ちですね。どのような受取方法をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a missed-delivery notice. How would you like to receive the parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここで受け取れるか聞きたいです。ただ、宛名は私ではなく同居している家族です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同居家族宛ての荷物を窓口で受け取れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to ask whether I can collect it here. However, it is addressed to a family member who lives with me, not to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can collect a parcel addressed to a family member living with you at the counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛名と保管先を確認しましょう。ご本人以外の受取りについては、担当が条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the addressee and holding location. The person responsible will check the conditions for collection by someone other than the addressee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この票に書かれた保管先が、こちらと同じかよくわかりません。先に確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 不在票の保管先が来訪した窓口か確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am not sure whether the holding location on this notice is the same as this place. Could you check that first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether the holding location on the notice is the counter you have visited. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保管先を調べます。今ここに荷物があると決めず、票の情報を確かめてからご案内しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will look up the holding location. I will check the notice before advising you, rather than assume the parcel is here now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。家族は夕方なら家にいるので、窓口受取りが難しければ再配達も相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 夕方の在宅予定から再配達も相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. My family member will be home in the evening, so if collecting at the counter is difficult, I would also like to discuss redelivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Also ask about redelivery based on your family member being home in the evening. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の予定を確かめたうえで、選べる方法を確認しましょう。受取りに必要な物も担当へ聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the available methods after confirming the addressee's schedule. Please also ask the person responsible what is required for collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族の予定をもう一度聞きます。私が受け取る場合と、家へ届けてもらう場合の確認点を分けて知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 代理受取りと再配達の確認点を分けて尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask my family member about their schedule again. I would like separate explanations of what to check if I collect it and if it is delivered to our home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask separately what must be checked for collection on someone's behalf and redelivery. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それぞれの確認点をご案内します。申込みができたかどうかまで確かめ、票を保管しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will explain the points for each option. Please check whether the request has actually been submitted and keep the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 保管先を確かめてから、家族の予定と受取り条件で方法を選びます。相談だけで予約できたとは思わず、申込み結果も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保管先と家族の予定と条件を確かめ結果も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: After checking the holding location, I will choose a method based on my family member's schedule and the collection conditions. I will not assume that asking about it made a booking; I will check the outcome of the request too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the holding location, family member's schedule, conditions, and request outcome. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、まず保管先の確認から進めます。不在票をこちらで拝見しますね。ご相談いただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us begin by checking the holding location. I will have a look at your missed-delivery notice. Thank you for coming to ask.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードが見当たらないとのご相談ですね。財布ごとなくされたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about a card you cannot find. Have you lost your whole wallet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 財布はありますが、いつも入れているカードだけがありません。利用を止める相談をしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 財布は手元にありカードだけがなく停止を相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have my wallet, but the card I usually keep in it is missing. I would like to ask about stopping its use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you still have your wallet but only the card is missing, and you want to ask about blocking it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのカードかと発行元を確認しましょう。カードの情報がわかる書類はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check which card it is and who issued it. Do you have any documents showing the card's details?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家から持ってきた案内があります。こちらで発行された物か自信がないので、案内を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参した案内から正しい相談先を探す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have some information I brought from home. I am not sure whether the card was issued here, so could you look at it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the information you brought to find the correct place to ask. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発行元を確認して連絡先をご案内します。この窓口で相談しただけで停止されたとはお考えにならず、担当先で状況を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the issuer and give you the contact details. Do not assume the card has been blocked just because you consulted this counter; check its status with the responsible office.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ停止が済んだわけではないのですね。担当先に連絡するとき、なくしたカードと停止希望を最初に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相談だけで停止済みと思わず担当先へ希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it has not been blocked yet. When contacting the responsible office, I will first explain which card is missing and that I want it blocked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not assume the consultation blocked the card; tell the responsible office what you want. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのように用件を伝えてください。手続きに必要な確認は担当先から案内されます。不明な点もそこで聞きましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain your request that way. The responsible office will explain the checks required for the procedure. Ask them about anything unclear too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内された内容がわからなければ聞き返します。停止の手続きが完了したかも、最後に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明な手順を聞き停止の完了を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I do not understand their instructions, I will ask again. I would also like to confirm at the end whether the blocking procedure is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about unclear steps and confirm that blocking is complete. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 完了した内容と、続けて必要な手続きがあるかを分けて確認してください。再発行についても条件を担当先へ相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please distinguish what has been completed from any further procedures required. You can also ask the responsible office about conditions for a replacement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内で発行元を確かめ、担当先へ停止を相談します。完了の確認と、再発行で必要なことを別々に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停止の完了と再発行の必要事項を分けて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use the information to check the issuer and contact the responsible office about blocking the card. I will ask separately whether blocking is complete and what is required for a replacement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask separately about completion of blocking and replacement requirements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、案内に書かれた連絡先を一緒に確認しましょう。担当先へ用件が伝わるようお手伝いします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us check the contact details in the information together. I will help you get your request across to the responsible office. Thank you for coming to ask.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品の状態についてですね。お持ちの商品を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about the condition of a product. Could you show me the item you have brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った乾物です。家で開けようとしたとき、袋の横に小さな破れがあるのに気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日買った乾物の袋の破れを家で見つけたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is dried food I bought yesterday. When I was about to open it at home, I noticed a small tear in the side of the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you found a tear in the bag of dried food bought yesterday when you were at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 気づいたときの状態を確認します。ご自分で袋を開ける前に見つけた、ということでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the condition when you noticed it. Did you find it before opening the bag yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、開ける前です。中身は使わず、別の袋に入れて持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 中身を使わず別の袋で持参したと知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, before opening it. I did not use the contents and brought it here inside another bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not use the contents and brought it in another bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま拝見します。購入した日時がわかるレシートや記録はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will look at it as it is. Do you have a receipt or record showing when you bought it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: レシートを持っています。同じ乾物を二袋買いましたが、もう一袋はまだ家にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: レシートと家に残る一袋の存在を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have the receipt. I bought two bags of the same dried food, but the other bag is still at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention the receipt and the other bag remaining at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの商品とレシートを確認します。もう一袋の状態については、今はまだわからないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check this product and the receipt. You do not yet know the condition of the other bag, is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もう一袋は調べていません。こちらの破れだけ確認していただき、どんな対応ができるか教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未確認の袋を除き持参した商品の対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not inspected the other bag. I would like you to check this tear and tell me what can be done about it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what can be done about the item you brought, without including the unexamined bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者へ状態と購入情報を伝えます。交換や返金などの対応は、確認結果をご案内してから相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass the condition and purchase details on to the person responsible. Let us discuss an exchange, refund, or other response after I explain the results of the check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 対応が決まったとは思わず、確認結果を待ちます。もう一袋を見て追加で気になる点があれば、改めて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認前に対応を決めつけず追加の状態も知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait for the results without assuming a response has been decided. If I inspect the other bag and find anything else concerning, I will let you know again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not presume a response before the check; also report any additional condition you find. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。商品を拝見して担当者へ確認しますので、レシートも一緒にお預かりします。お持ちいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will inspect the product and check with the person responsible, so I will take the receipt with it. Thank you for bringing it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩と写生をされるのですね。持っていらっしゃる物も含めて、どんな場所をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are going for a walk and sketching. What sort of place would you like, taking into account what you have brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 折り畳み椅子と画材があります。荷物を持って坂を上るのは大変なので、平らな道を歩きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 椅子と画材を持って坂を避けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a folding chair and art supplies. Climbing slopes with my belongings is difficult, so I would like to walk on a flat path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are carrying a chair and art supplies and want to avoid slopes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内図で起伏の少ない候補を探しましょう。休憩には園内のベンチを使うことも考えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us find some routes with little elevation change on the map. Are you also considering using the park benches for breaks?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、ベンチなら椅子を広げずに済みます。絵を描きながら休める場所を先に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 椅子を広げず写生できる場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, with a bench I would not need to unfold my chair. I would like to know in advance where I can rest while drawing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask where you can sketch without unfolding your chair. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 候補は図で確認できますが、空いているかは現地で確かめてください。持参した椅子の利用についても掲示を見ておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check possible places on the map, but please check whether they are available when you get there. Also look at the notices about using your own chair.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベンチが空いていなくても、通路で椅子を広げないようにします。使える場所がわからなければスタッフに聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通路へ広げず不明ならスタッフに尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even if the benches are occupied, I will not unfold my chair in the walkway. If I am unsure where I can use it, I will ask a staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not unfold it in the walkway; ask staff if unsure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうしてください。画材を片付ける時間も考えて、疲れない範囲で戻る道を決めておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. Allow time to pack your art supplies away, and decide on a return route that will not tire you out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 行きに坂を避けても、帰りに別の道へ進むと登りになるかもしれません。同じ平らな道で戻る案を図に印してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰りの登りも避ける同じ道を図で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even if I avoid slopes on the way out, another route back might go uphill. Could you mark a route returning along the same flat path on the map?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the same route on the map to avoid an uphill return as well. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 候補の往復経路を示します。道の表示を現地でも確かめ、無理に遠くまで進まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will show you a possible route out and back. Check the signs on site too, and do not push yourself to go too far.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 往復の候補を確かめて歩き、空いている休憩場所で写生します。椅子の条件が不明なら広げず、疲れる前に画材を片付けて戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩場所と利用条件を確認し片付けて戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the proposed route both ways, walk along it, and sketch at an available resting place. If I am unsure about chair-use conditions, I will not unfold it; I will pack my art supplies and return before getting tired.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check resting places and use conditions, then pack up and return. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 画材も持ち帰り、ほかの方が通れるようにお願いします。気持ちよく絵を描けるといいですね。それでは、散歩をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your art supplies home too, and leave space for others to pass. I hope you enjoy drawing. Have a pleasant walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗車券の見本をご覧ですね。まだ購入の操作はしていませんので、先にご予定を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at a sample ticket. No purchase has been made yet, so please tell me your plans first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 途中の停留所で友人と合流してから海辺へ行きたいです。この券で一度降りて、次のバスに乗れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人と途中で合流する予定を示し降車後も次の便で使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to meet a friend at a stop along the way and then go to the seaside. Can I get off once with this ticket and board the next bus?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your plan to meet a friend along the way and ask whether the ticket can be used on the next service after getting off. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用の見本には、一回の乗車用と書いてあります。途中で降りた後も使える券とは読み取れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This practice sample says it is for one ride. It does not appear to be a ticket you can reuse after getting off partway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一回分なのですね。それなら合流する所まで買い、その先は友人と一緒に考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一回の乗車用と確認し合流先まで買って先の区間は友人と考えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it is for one ride. In that case, I would like to buy a ticket to the meeting point and discuss the rest with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that it is for one ride; say you will buy to the meeting point and discuss the next section with your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 区間を分ける案ですね。こちらのもう一つの見本には、利用する便を指定する欄もあります。便は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you are considering splitting the journey. This other sample also has a field specifying the service to use. Have you chosen a service?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人からまだ到着時刻の返事がないので、便は決められません。先に買うより待った方がよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の到着時刻が未回答なので購入を待つ判断を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend has not replied with their arrival time yet, so I cannot choose a service. It seems better to wait rather than buy in advance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your decision to wait before buying because your friend has not replied with an arrival time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返事が来てから候補の便を比べましょう。集合場所の停留所名は、案内に書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us compare possible services after the reply comes. Does the information give the name of the meeting stop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 海辺入口と書いてあります。ただ、反対向きのバス乗り場にも同じ名前があるので、どちらで会うのか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同名の反対方向の停留所があり集合側を友人に尋ねると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It says “Seaside Entrance.” But the stop for buses going the other way has the same name, so I will ask which side we are meeting on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention the identically named opposite-direction stop and say you will ask your friend which side to meet on. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 乗り場の向きまでそろえば相談を進められます。返事を受け取る間、券の見本をお持ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you have also agreed on the direction of the stop, we can proceed. Would you like to take the sample ticket while waiting for the reply?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見本を見ながら、時刻と乗り場の向きを友人に確認します。今日は購入せず、返事を受けてから戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 見本を使って時刻と乗り場の向きを確認し返事の後に再相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use the sample to check the time and the stop's direction with my friend. I will not buy today; I will return after getting their reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use the sample to check the time and stop direction, and say you will consult again after the reply. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、行き先と便の相談は返事がそろってから続けましょう。それでは、また窓口でお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us continue discussing the destination and service once you have all the replies. We will look forward to seeing you at the counter again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知をお持ちですね。内容の説明をご希望ですか、それとも担当の窓口をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a notice with you. Would you like its contents explained, or are you looking for the relevant counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 担当窓口を探しています。前の住所に届いた通知ですが、右下の担当課の文字が薄くて読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧住所への通知で担当課の文字が薄く相談窓口を探していると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am looking for the relevant counter. This notice was delivered to my previous address, but the department name at the bottom right is too faint to read.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the notice went to your old address, the department name is faint, and you are looking for the right counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒にも差出し元の記載があるか見てみましょう。通知はどなた宛てになっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us see whether the sender is also shown on the envelope. Who is the notice addressed to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私宛てです。封筒は持っていますが、古い住所のままなので、住所変更も同じ所で相談できるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人宛てで封筒もあると伝え古い登録住所を同じ所で相談できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is addressed to me. I have the envelope, but it still shows my old address, so I would like to know whether I can ask about changing my address at the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it is addressed to you and you have the envelope; ask whether the same office handles the old registered address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通知の内容と住所の登録は、担当が同じとは限りません。本文にはどのような用件が書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The notice's subject and address registration are not necessarily handled by the same office. What is the notice about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 地域説明会の参加確認とあります。住所の変更とは分けて、まず説明会の問い合わせ先を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地域説明会の参加確認と示しまずその問い合わせ先を知りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says confirmation of attendance at a community information meeting. Separate from changing my address, I would first like to check whom to contact about that meeting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that it concerns attendance at a community information meeting, and that you first want its contact details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この練習用通知では、上の欄に問い合わせ先の表示があります。本文と封筒を担当者へ見せて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: On this practice notice, the contact details are shown in the top field. Let us show the body of the notice and the envelope to the person responsible and check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 両方見せます。通知には返答の期日もあるので、今日その日付を読み違えていないか確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封筒と本文を見せ期日の日付も読み違いがないか確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will show both. There is also a response deadline on the notice, so could you check today whether I have read that date correctly?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the envelope and notice and have the deadline date checked for any misreading. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 期日の表示も一緒に確認しましょう。住所変更について尋ねたいことは、別のメモに残すと整理できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the deadline together too. Writing your address-change questions in a separate note can help keep things organized.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通知の問い合わせ先と期日を先に確認し、住所の登録については別のメモで相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通知の連絡先と期日を先に確認し住所の登録を別メモで相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the notice's contact details and deadline first, and consult about my registered address using a separate note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will first check the notice's contact details and deadline, and use a separate note to discuss address registration. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、通知を確認する担当へご案内します。それでは、封筒と本文をお持ちのままこちらへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will take you to the person who checks this notice. Please come this way with both the envelope and the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めてこちらへお越しですか。受付方法のご相談があれば、先に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this your first visit here? If you have questions about checking in, I can hear them first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 初めてです。別の施設でもらった封筒を持っていますが、開けて中の書類を出すのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初診で他施設の封筒があり開けて書類を出す必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is my first visit. I have an envelope from another facility; should I open it and take out the documents inside?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that this is your first consultation and you have an envelope from another facility; ask whether you should open it to remove the documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習場面では、封筒のまま受付担当に見せて確認します。予約の案内も受け取っていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this practice situation, you show the envelope unopened to the reception staff and check. Have you also received appointment information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約の案内はこの紙です。封筒と紙を一緒に渡せばよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約案内の紙を提示し封筒と一緒に渡すと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The appointment information is on this paper. So I should hand over the envelope and this paper together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the appointment paper and confirm handing it over with the envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つを受付担当へ見せてください。その後の案内を受け取ってから、待つ場所を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show both to the reception staff. After receiving their instructions, check where to wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 待つ場所が決まったら、名前で呼ばれるか番号で呼ばれるかも聞きたいです。聞き逃さないか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待機場所の後に名前か番号かを確認したいと述べ聞き逃しが心配と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Once I know where to wait, I would also like to ask whether I will be called by name or number. I am worried I might miss the call.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After checking where to wait, ask whether you will be called by name or number and explain your concern about missing it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 呼び出し方は受付担当に確認しましょう。表示がある場合は、どこを見るかも尋ねられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check how you will be called with reception. If there is a display, you can also ask where to look.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表示の場所も尋ねます。名前の読み方を間違えられやすいので、受付で読み方を伝えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示の場所も聞くと答え間違えられやすい名前の読みを受付で伝えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will ask where the display is too. People often misread my name, so may I tell reception how it is pronounced?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask where the display is, and ask whether to tell reception the pronunciation of your easily misread name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 読み方の確認をお願いすると伝わりやすいですね。呼び出しがわからなかったときは、受付に声を掛けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Asking them to confirm the pronunciation will make it easier to communicate. If you do not understand a call, please speak to reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付で名前の読み方と呼び出し方を確認します。わからないまま別の場所へ行かず、受付に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名前の読みと呼び出しを確認し不明なまま移動せず受付へ尋ねると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check my name's pronunciation and how I will be called at reception. Rather than go elsewhere without understanding, I will ask reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the pronunciation and calling method, and say you will ask reception instead of moving elsewhere while unsure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、封筒と予約の紙を持って受付へお進みください。それでは、担当の案内を受けてからお待ちくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-39209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take the envelope and appointment paper to reception. Wait after receiving the staff's instructions.
